description: Data for "Rapid seaward expansion of seaport footprints worldwide is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors Dhritiraj Sengupta, Eli D Lazarus (Environmental Dynamics Lab, School of Geography & Environmental Science, University of Southampton). [updated October 2023] This dataset comprises data and code used in "Rapid seaward expansion of seaport footprints worldwide" (Sengupta & Lazarus, 2023; preprint: https://doi.org/10.31223/X5SD3T). Coverage: global; the metadata date the deposit to 2023. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
